scientific_integrity.limitations: Only full injective-word complexes and alternating relabeling quotients; no other subgroup or Borel construction; small-case code is corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: Uniform orbit-cell CW calculation; exceptional low-dimensional n=3 handled by explicit attaching words.
scientific_integrity.statement: Complete ordinary orbit-space homotopy classification for every integer n >= 3.

title: Alternating-label quotients of injective-word complexes are Moore spaces
